summary: PM-PILOT-001 + PM-ADMIN-001 (Administrator Workspace + Building Health Score + Announcements + Invite flow) fully validated. 17/17 backend pytest cases PASS covering P1-P7 (create with administrator_id, PATCH permissions/validation, portfolio + totals, health score 5 weighted components with detail strings, dashboard access matrix, announcements + notifications, preview no-sensitive-data, /buildings/mine is_admin + announcements). Frontend F1-F4 fully validated with Playwright: /administrator portfolio (aw-totals, aw-building-{id}, aw-dot-{id}, /100 score) → click card → BuildingDetail (aw-health-score, aw-health-breakdown with 5 bars, aw-apartments, aw-invite-link containing /register?binvite=, aw-invite-copy, aw-invite-wa, aw-announce form + live insertion into aw-announcements). BuildingHub on /client shows bh-share-{id}, bh-admin-link-{id} pointing to /administrator, bh-announcements-{id}. F4 invite flow: created secondary test client account, logged in as invitee, navigated to /client?binvite={bid} → bh-invite-banner visible with building name → click bh-invite-accept → banner disappears and bh-building-{id} card appears in portfolio. All test data cleaned (5 test buildings, 2 test invitee accounts, all announcements/notifications/campaigns removed).
critical_code_review_comments: compute_building_health does two DB round-trips for the same building doc when called from portfolio (b passed in) vs dashboard — already optimized by passing b. Good.
AdministratorWorkspace.jsx uses setSelected as effect dep with axios.get — re-fetches portfolio on every drill-in/back. Minor: could refresh only on back. Non-blocking.
In building_dashboard the ObjectId conversion for owners uses ObjectId.is_valid check — good defensive coding.
Preview endpoint correctly excludes administrator_id/apartments_total/floors/construction_year (verified explicitly in P6 test).
